name: Edwards Deming
excerpt: Edwards Deming influenced the Quality Revolution in Japan.
notes: Edwards Deming was instrumental in the Quality Revolution, teaching Japanese manufacturers about quality management, which led to Japan's rise in manufacturing quality post-WWII.
